extDescription: Blocks ads and trackers, keeps pages quiet. Nothing else.
gemeinsam.preisHinweis: The price is shown on the checkout page.
gemeinsam.kaufHinweis: The checkout page opens in a new tab.
gemeinsam.fehler.hintergrund: The background service is not responding. Please reload the extension.
gemeinsam.fehler.netz: No connection to the service. Blocking keeps running.
gemeinsam.fehler.dienst: Service currently unavailable, blocking keeps running.
gemeinsam.offline: Offline. The last known state applies.
gemeinsam.neuVerbinden: The connection has expired. Please connect again.
gemeinsam.zahlungOffen: Payment pending. Please check your account.
premium.einleitung: One subscription, every extra: automatic cookie answers, browser fingerprint blurring, lookalike warnings, daily list updates.
premium.keinTarif: No plan is available right now.
premium.keinPreis: No price is available for this billing period.
popup.site.zaehlerFehlt: Counter not available in this browser
warnung.satz: This page looks like {marke} but does not belong to it. Anyone entering a password or bank details here hands them to strangers.
warnung.bleiben: I know what I am doing
popup.premium.text: Answer cookie dialogs automatically, sync across devices.
popup.premium.verbindenText: Connect your account so your plan applies here.
popup.meldung.text: This is what will be sent, nothing else:
popup.meldung.kommentarHinweis: Optional. Please do not include personal data.
popup.meldung.fehler: Sending did not work. Please try again later.
popup.meldung.keineSeite: Nothing to report for this page.
optionen.nav.label: Sections
optionen.listen.grund.name: Blocker Lite
optionen.listen.regionalText: The more languages you add, the slower your browser can get, it downloads thousands of rules per language.
optionen.listen.basis.name: Ads
optionen.listen.privatsphaere.name: Tracking
optionen.listen.ublock.name: Additional rules
optionen.listen.ublock.text: An addition to the foundation, carries the countermeasures against adblock detection.
optionen.listen.ublockPrivatsphaere.name: Tracking, extended
optionen.listen.ublockPrivatsphaere.text: Further trackers that appear less often.
optionen.listen.ublockSchadsoftware.name: Badware
optionen.listen.ublockSchadsoftware.text: Sites and scripts that cause harm.
optionen.listen.ublockEilig.name: Quick fixes
optionen.listen.ublockReparatur.name: Site repair
optionen.listen.ublockReparatur.text: Takes back rules that break sites.
optionen.listen.antiadblock.name: Adblock detection
optionen.listen.antiadblock.text: Removes the request to turn off your ad blocker on sites that show it.
optionen.listen.laestig.name: Annoyances
optionen.listen.laestig.text: Discount overlays, pop-ups, push notifications, age gates.
optionen.listen.cookies.name: Cookie banners
optionen.listen.cookies.text: Hides cookie notices and consent windows.
optionen.listen.regionalDe.name: Germany
optionen.ausnahmen.text: AdSilence blocks nothing on these sites.
optionen.ausnahmen.leer: No exceptions. A site can be turned off from the popup.
optionen.ausnahmen.ungueltig: That is not a valid host.
optionen.ausnahmen.schonDa: This site is already on the list.
optionen.regeln.text: One rule per line, in EasyList syntax.
optionen.regeln.hinweis: ||example.com^ blocks a host, @@||example.com^ allows it, example.com##.ad hides an element.
optionen.konto.codeText: Approve this code on the website. It is valid for ten minutes.
optionen.konto.name: Name
optionen.konto.abgleichText: Keep settings and exceptions the same on all devices. Part of Premium.
optionen.einstellungen.warnungText: Flags addresses that look deceptively like a well-known brand.
optionen.einstellungen.cookiesText: Clicks the button for you, on {anzahl} known consent tools.
optionen.einstellungen.cookiesAblehnenHi: Only where the site offers a reject button. Some ask again on a second layer, and there the dialog stays.
optionen.einstellungen.pflegeText: Updates once a day (new fake sites etc.)
optionen.einstellungen.pflegeUebergangen: {anzahl} rules no longer fit the quota.
optionen.einstellungen.pflegeVeraltet: The last run was too long ago.
optionen.einstellungen.fingerabdruckText: Websites can no longer recognise you.
optionen.einstellungen.fingerabdruckTipp: Canvas, audio and device data get a slight noise. That way your browser can no longer be recognised, even without cookies.
optionen.einstellungen.badgeText: Shows on the icon how many requests were blocked on the page.
optionen.ueber.datenschutz: AdSilence sends no visited addresses and no usage data. The service only receives what you trigger yourself: sign-in, purchase and reports you see beforehand.
optionen.listen.tarnung.name: Disguised trackers
optionen.listen.tarnung.text: Tracking services that pose as the site’s own address.
optionen.listen.hosts.name: Known ad servers
optionen.listen.hosts.text: Whole domains rather than single paths.
optionen.listen.urlhaus.name: Malicious addresses
optionen.listen.urlhaus.text: Addresses serving malware right now. Refreshed twice a day.
optionen.listen.heimnetz.name: Shield your home network
optionen.listen.heimnetz.text: Stops websites from probing your router, printer or network storage.
